 Print File photo: Larsen & Toubro NEW DELHI: Engineering major Larsen & Toubro (L&T) on Tuesday reported a 32.5% rise in net profit to Rs 5,202 crore for the quarter ended Sept 2026, driven by higher revenue. The company had posted a profit of Rs 3,926 crore in the year-ago period. L&T achieved consolidated revenue of Rs 78,750 crore for the reporting quarter, up 16% y-o-y.
